what_was_wrong: Amendment 2's ARM_MIRROR sealed prediction said the mirror arm's event/occupancy structure is 'the exact mirror of ARM_TWO (relabel x -> 63-x)'. Pure analysis of the kernel's fixed iteration order (qthe.mjs tick(): row-major, left-to-right, y outer / x inner) shows this literal reading is NOT model-neutral: reflection x -> 63-x REVERSES the direction of the kernel's fixed write order. Under S3 (live-read row-major LWW), the t1 firing cell in ARM_TWO is the LATER column (x=20); in ARM_MIRROR (writers {43,53}) the t1 firing cell is ALSO the later column (x=53) — which is the mirror image of TWO's EARLIER writer (mirror(10)=53), not of TWO's firing cell (mirror(20)=43). So the literal sealed prediction 'firing at 43' is an S2 (batch-LWW) signature, not an S3 one.
why_this_sharpens_rather_than_weakens: The literal mirror cell at t1 (43 vs 53) is itself a clean S2/S3 discriminator: S2 predicts 43 (batch reads see the final row-major occupant (53)? no — batch reads see the final WRITER's tuple: in MIRROR the final t1 writer is x=53, so batch's firing cell at t1 is x=43 reading occupant (53)); S3 predicts 53 (predecessor audibility). The erratum therefore converts an ambiguous invariance claim into a discriminating observation.
corrected_invariance_for_ARM_MIRROR: SEALED (pre-run): the position-respecting invariant of a fixed-direction kernel is ROLE-isomorphism, not label mirroring: in BOTH TWO and MIRROR, the first writer in row-major order is silent at t1 (reads an empty slot), the second writer fires at t1 (reads its predecessor), and the t1 occupant is the second writer (LWW by row-major order). Additionally sealed as a KERNEL PROPERTY finding (either way it falls): under S3 the substrate is NOT reflection-symmetric in audibility — audibility flows left-to-right; a reflected writer pair fires at the reflected-earlier column. This is directionality of the specified order, not order-DEPENDENCE across equivalent runs (EQ6-D1 still governs that).
ARM_SHIFT_added: NEW control arm (order-PRESERVING translation, no new primitives): 64x1, Abstain ONLY at x=11 and x=21 (writers {10,20} shifted +1), rest Ground; T=8; run twice. SEALED prediction (S3): role-structure IDENTICAL to ARM_TWO with labels shifted +1 (t1: x=11 silent, x=21 fires, occupant (21,0); t2: x=11 fires reading previous-tick occupant (21) of slot 0, x=21 silent at empty slot 1; leapfrog ladder identical tick-for-tick). Any structural divergence = hidden positional asymmetry (e.g., toroidal seam adjacency) => receipted as a finding.
